bio: Sarienne has been a gunsmith since she was fifteen, making custom weapons for Freeborn pirates with whatever strange materials they could bring her. Becoming a Magi gave her the best material of all: magic. She put everything she had into her Empyreal Railbolt – and it was worth every drop of sweat.
